paragraphs: The software on this site is sold under the name Neumo, and it handles transactions and interactions between government agencies and the communities they serve. The catalog spans revenue compliance, court management, DMV services and integrated payments.

On the revenue side, the products listed are tax and licensing, short-term rental compliance, auditing and unclaimed property. Court, jury and probation systems sit under the justice line. Public administration covers land records, vitals, records search and pension. A shared platform layer adds reporting and analytics, forms, digital processing, ID verification, eSignatures, alerts and managed IT services.

The company claims 4,500+ state and local agencies across North America as customers. Those buyers are described as city, county, state and federal agencies. One published case study describes how Oregon DMV extended access beyond office hours with self-service kiosks.

quote.text: Neumo provides software that powers transactions and interactions between government and the communities they serve.
